how: We read the website of every Tampa wedding florist listed on Lazo (177 listings, 143 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops, a bridal gown boutique, a jeweler that also sells flowers, and wedding venues that were listed as florists. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What survives four hours outdoors in a Florida summer, through the ceremony and cocktail hour, and what wilts?
Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
Can I see a full wedding's florals at a budget like mine, not just a bouquet photo?

picks.name: 2Birds Events
picks.blurb: A full-service wedding floral team in Gulfport that believes design should be refined, dimensional and speak to who you are. 2Birds reads your inspiration pictures and interprets them, no flower names required, and lists personal flowers and arches built with unusual stems.

picks.name: Alta Fleura
picks.blurb: The owner sold wildflower bunches to neighbors at age ten and has worked in flowers for more than 45 years since. Alta Fleura in Valrico designs wedding florals around each couple's style and has been featured on WeddingWire.

picks.name: Marigold Flower Co.
picks.blurb: A wedding floral boutique in Tampa that works exclusively with flowers and uses only seasonally appropriate stems for each bride. Marigold publishes a pricing guide that answers how much to budget by price point, and serves St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Sarasota, Bradenton, Dade City, Brandon and Lakeland.

picks.name: Botanica International Design & Decor Studio
picks.blurb: Founded in 1989 by Ian Prosser, who served as Design Chairperson for George W. Bush's second inauguration and has worked for Queen Elizabeth and Elton John. Botanica is Tampa's floral and event design studio for couples who want a thematic concept taken to the next level.

picks.name: Florist Fire Design House
picks.blurb: Gayle Zerr founded Florist Fire Design House in 2010 with two decades in the field behind her, and the site calls her a master florist, event curator and spatial designer. Tampa-based, with weddings, social events and editorials in the portfolio.

picks.name: Apple Blossoms Floral Designs
picks.blurb: Hands-on, relaxed floral design in Tampa for weddings, private and corporate events. Apple Blossoms says its wedding florals have graced venues including The Don CeSar, and promises service one step beyond excellence.

picks.name: Arms Of Persephone Floral Design
picks.blurb: Started in 2019 from a one-bedroom apartment kitchen table and now a collective of florists in St. Petersburg, doing seasonal, sustainable wedding design that honors the couple's narrative. Arms of Persephone also runs what it calls Florida's first flower drive-thru.

picks.name: Iza's Flowers, Inc
picks.blurb: A wedding and event floristry studio in Pinellas Park that handles weddings of any size with full-service production and draws on the founder's European background. Iza's makes a point of not being a design-and-drop florist.

picks.name: BOTERA Floral & Event Design
picks.blurb: A Clearwater wedding florist that prints its packages: the Minimalist Grace starts at $1,100 and covers a bridal bouquet, a bridesmaid bouquet, two boutonnieres and two arch designs for intimate weddings and elopements. Larger packages are listed the same way.

picks.name: Swan and Stem
picks.blurb: Madison runs what she calls Lakeland's only designer's-choice florist, doing daily blooms, parties and weddings, and says outdoor weddings are her favorite to work. Her current focus is joyful, climate-friendly designs built on reusable chicken wire bundles.

picks.name: Lemon Drops Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: A one-stop shop in St. Petersburg for floral arrangements, decor rentals and planning or coordination packages, started by a couple in their garage and grown from there. The founder came to it after planning her niece's wedding.

picks.name: Wonderland Floral Art and Gift Loft
picks.blurb: A family-owned St. Petersburg florist that does weddings and events alongside its shop, seeks out eco-responsible farms, recycles and composts. Wonderland pitches innovative designs and sharing its flower know-how with customers.
